description: Convert question-mark placeholders to the requested bind marker style while preserving escaped literal question marks.

input.template: SELECT uuid, "data" #> '{tags}' AS tags FROM nodes WHERE  "data" -> 'tags' ??| array['?'] AND enabled = ?

cases.expected_output: sql=SELECT uuid, "data" #> '{tags}' AS tags FROM nodes WHERE  "data" -> 'tags' ?| array['$1'] AND enabled = $2
